verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI's first-party docs describe "deferred tools," with a dedicated flavor for "tools that require approval" by the user before they execute. This directly maps to gating specific sensitive tool calls. Durable execution docs add support for long-running human-in-the-loop workflows, so a pause for approval can survive restarts. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval flow, and evidence detailing how approval is configured per tool or conditionally on arguments and how approve/deny results are fed back into the run.
